facts.value: The Unibator is seen as an 'incubator for innovation' at Goethe University. It supports students, staff, and alumni from all departments in implementing scientific findings and emerging business ideas into market-ready products and services.

The AndersGründer project at the Social Impact Lab Frankfurt supports startups in founding their social enterprises, with coaching, qualification, co-working, and access to relevant networks.

Higher education institutions of the FrankfurtRheinMain knowledge region come together and bundle their competencies in supporting startup initiatives from the academic environment at a central internet portal.
Interested students, early-stage startups, or growing startups.
